ExxonMobil's net cash provided by operating activities fell about 16.6% from Q1 2024 to Q4 2024.

- **Q1 2024:** Net cash provided by operating activities was $14,664 million.
- **Q4 2024:** The 10-K gives $55,022 million for the full year. The 10-Q for the nine months ended September 30, 2024, shows $42,793 million. The difference is $12,229 million for Q4. The Q4 earnings release confirms this, saying cash flow from operating activities was $12.2 billion.

The change is (12,229 − 14,664) / 14,664 ≈ −16.6%.
